articles.title: First Starship V3 launch slips
articles.summary:
SpaceX is pushing back the first launch of the latest version of Starship even as NASA is asking it to accelerate work on a lunar lander version of the vehicle.

articles.title: Chinese official calls for prioritizing Neptune orbiter mission
articles.summary:

articles.title: Smile arrives at Europe’s Spaceport
articles.summary: The Smile spacecraft has arrived at Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana. During the coming weeks, the spacecraft will go through final preparations for its launch on a Vega-C rocket between 8 April and 7 May.

articles.title: ESA analysing fireball over Europe on 8 March 2026
articles.summary: At approximately 18:55 CET (17:55 UTC) on Sunday 8 March 2026, a very bright fireball moving from the southwest to the northeast was observed by many people in Belgium, France, Germany, Luxembourg, and the Netherlands.
